test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The Kumbh Mela (the festival of the sacred Pitcher) is the world's biggest peaceful gathering of pilgrims, with participants bathing or taking the dip in the _____ river.
solution:
The correct answer is '**sacred**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**sacred**" means connected with God or dedicated to a religious purpose and so deserving veneration. (पवित्र)
 
• The Kumbh Mela is a significant religious event, and pilgrims consider the river sacred for taking a holy dip.
 
• The other options: "**depth**," "**profane**," and "**shallow**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The Kumbh Mela (the festival of the sacred Pitcher) is the world's biggest peaceful gathering of pilgrims, with participants bathing or taking the dip in the sacred__ river.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Depth (गहराई)**: means the distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.
 
• **Profane (अशुद्ध)**: means not respectful of religious practice; secular rather than sacred.
 
• **Shallow (उथला)**: means of little depth.
